chunks: As for what is in it from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr al-Bajalī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr al-Bajalī.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplicatory honorific meaning 'may Allah be pleased with him.'
key_terms.عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ الْبَجَلِيِّ: Indicates transmission from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr al-Bajalī as the source narrator.
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: A transmission formula meaning 'I have narrated it,' indicating the author’s route of report.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr al-Bajalī in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr al-Bajalī in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission and preserving hadith attribution within Shia hadith scholarship.
